summary.decision_summary: Nacua-Cola won by 24.9. Nacua-Cola left 5.9 lineup points on the table, while Love(land) Hurts left 7.9.
summary.historical_summary: Nacua-Cola is 14-19 against Love(land) Hurts across 33 meetings between these managers.
summary.winner_reason: Nacua-Cola won by 24.9, led by a 25.3-point edge at RB. The leading starters were Kirk Cousins (35.5) and Bhayshul Tuten (32.9).
summary.loser_reason: Love(land) Hurts could not match the opponent's RB production, losing that position battle by 25.3 points. Seahawks scored 2.0. A best legal lineup added 7.9, still short of the 24.9-point margin.
